reason: I pick dinner from a cooking video on the day, and the kitchen is run by my helper and my routine, not an app. Scanning receipts and planning a week is not how we cook.
objection: Nobody in my house would actually keep the app updated. My helper does the shopping and the kitchen, so I would be paying for something that sits unused.
would_change_my_mind: If it linked straight to the cooking videos I already watch and my helper could use it easily in Arabic without any setup.
